summary.intent: Determine whether GitHub issue 1131 (moving the stage-3 section predicate from the engine crate into core behind a verified commitment witness) is still valid and, if so, get it moving given it's a core architectural change with growing ripple effects; then draft the required ADR once the user clarified the v2.0.0 milestone was closed and ADRs now live in this repo.
summary.outcome: Confirmed issue 1131 is still valid and unimplemented, produced a detailed ripple/impact analysis and recommended path, then created ADR 0052 in the cipher-box repo's decisions folder, added its README row, and amended ADR 0032 (D8) and ADR 0033 (D2) with 'Amended by' cross-references, committing the result.

workflow: ADR authoring workflow in this repo: read decisions/ README + latest ADR number, pick a template (prefer a non-retroactive ADR over a retroactive one), fast-forward main, create a branch, write the ADR file, add its README row, add 'Amended by' sentences to the ADRs it supersedes, then format/lint before committing

When an issue's proposed decision changes an existing architectural document (blueprint), the recorded process requires drafting/accepting an ADR first, then doing the code move and doc reword in the same PR after acceptance
